from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib, json, re

BASE=Path('/home/lyh/MAPF_SCI_RESEARCH/tracks/sci')
BATCH=BASE/'results/address_reward_cost_diagnostic_v1'
EXPECTED='8bb0f27232f4ff25a3509f58b2084b75cdd91b4b29b8bb047eb704adc22ae257'
MANIFEST='baf2255de8838c2d3bc2dc253523693fe78f9e3ceb24a04dad495a1b0aedf3cd'
def sha(raw): return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def read_json(path): return json.loads(path.read_bytes())
def audit_plan(case, raw_paths):
    paths={int(k):v for k,v in raw_paths.items()}
    endpoints={int(k):v for k,v in case['endpoints'].items()}
    assert paths.keys()==endpoints.keys()
    blocked=set(case['blocked']); nr,nc=case['rows'],case['cols']
    for a,p in paths.items():
        assert p and [p[0],p[-1]]==endpoints[a]
        assert all(type(q) is int and 0<=q<nr*nc and q not in blocked for q in p)
        assert all(abs(x//nc-y//nc)+abs(x%nc-y%nc)<=1 for x,y in zip(p,p[1:]))
    horizon=max(map(len,paths.values()))
    previous={a:p[0] for a,p in paths.items()}
    for t in range(horizon):
        now={a:p[min(t,len(p)-1)] for a,p in paths.items()}
        assert len(set(now.values()))==len(now)
        if t:
            edges={}
            for a,v in now.items():
                u=previous[a]
                assert u==v or (v,u) not in edges
                edges[(u,v)]=a
        previous=now
    return sum(len(p)-1 for p in paths.values()),max(len(p)-1 for p in paths.values())
def raw_path_parse(raw,cols):
    result={}
    for line in raw.decode().splitlines():
        m=re.fullmatch(r'Agent ([0-9]+):(.*)',line)
        assert m
        a=int(m[1]); assert a not in result
        coords=re.findall(r'\(([0-9]+),([0-9]+)\)->',m[2])
        assert ''.join('('+x+','+y+')->' for x,y in coords)==m[2]
        result[a]=[int(x)*cols+int(y) for x,y in coords]
    return result

def audit():
    receipt_raw=(BATCH/'RUN_RECEIPT.json').read_bytes(); assert sha(receipt_raw)==EXPECTED
    receipt=json.loads(receipt_raw)
    cfg_path=BASE/'config/address_reward_cost_diagnostic_v1_manifest.json'
    cfg_raw=cfg_path.read_bytes(); assert sha(cfg_raw)==MANIFEST
    cfg=json.loads(cfg_raw)
    inputs=(cfg_path.parent/cfg['input_file']).read_bytes(); assert sha(inputs)==cfg['input_sha256']
    cases={c['id']:c for c in json.loads(inputs)['cases']}
    assert receipt['scientific_code_commit']=='e8edaff2661d04c38789fa6189f32409f9c85b6b'
    assert receipt['status']=='ALL_COMPLETE' and receipt['counts']=={'COMPLETE':6,'FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE':0,'NOT_RUN_AFTER_BATCH_STOP':0}
    for name,pin in receipt['artifacts'].items():
        raw=(BATCH/name).read_bytes(); assert sha(raw)==pin['sha256'] and len(raw)==pin['bytes']
    for group in ('code_sha256','build_source_sha256'):
        for name,digest in cfg[group].items(): assert sha((BASE/name).read_bytes())==digest
    assert sha((BASE/cfg['binary']).read_bytes())==cfg['binary_sha256']
    auth=read_json(BATCH/'AUTHORIZATION.json'); outer=read_json(BATCH/'OUTER_EXECUTION.json')
    assert auth['manifest_sha256']==MANIFEST and auth['scientific_code_commit']==receipt['scientific_code_commit']
    assert auth['user_reply_verbatim']=='授权' and auth['jobs']==[j['id'] for j in cfg['jobs']]
    assert outer['attempts']==6 and outer['retry']==0 and outer['authorization_consumed_or_closed']
    assert [r['job'] for r in outer['records']]==auth['jobs']
    for before,after in zip(outer['records'],outer['records'][1:]):
        delta=(datetime.fromisoformat(after['started_at_utc'])-datetime.fromisoformat(before['started_at_utc'])).total_seconds()
        assert delta*1e9>=before['outer_command_wall_ns']
    per_job=[]; families={}; total_events=0; total_pin_count=0
    for job, outer_row, batch_row in zip(cfg['jobs'],outer['records'],receipt['jobs']):
        folder=BATCH/job['id']; rec=read_json(folder/'receipt.json'); result=read_json(folder/'result.json')
        native=read_json(folder/'native_receipt.json'); attempt=read_json(folder/'attempt.json')
        assert attempt['status']=='CONSUMED_ONCE' and attempt['retries']==0
        assert rec['job']==result['job']==attempt['job']==job
        assert rec['manifest_sha256']==result['manifest_sha256']==attempt['manifest_sha256']==MANIFEST
        assert rec['status']==result['status']==outer_row['receipt_status']=='COMPLETE'
        assert outer_row['returncode']==0 and outer_row['retry']==0 and outer_row['outer_command_wall_ns']<12e9
        assert rec['costs']['exit_code']==0 and not rec['costs']['forced_cleanup'] and not rec['retry_allowed']
        assert rec['total_entry_through_output_validation_and_hash_ns']<5e9
        for name,pin in rec['artifacts'].items():
            raw=(folder/name).read_bytes(); assert sha(raw)==pin['sha256'] and len(raw)==pin['bytes']; total_pin_count+=1
        assert native==result['native_receipt']
        assert 0<=native['inner_cpu_s']<10 and 0<=result['worker_cpu_ns']<10e9
        initial_soc,initial_makespan=audit_plan(cases[job['case']],cases[job['case']]['paths'])
        final_soc,final_makespan=audit_plan(cases[job['case']],result['final_paths'])
        parsed=raw_path_parse((folder/'final.paths').read_bytes(),cases[job['case']]['cols'])
        assert parsed=={int(k):v for k,v in result['final_paths'].items()}
        assert initial_soc==result['initial_soc']==native['initial_soc']==batch_row['initial_soc']
        assert final_soc==result['final_soc']==native['final_soc']==batch_row['final_soc']
        assert final_makespan==result['final_makespan']==batch_row['final_makespan'] and final_soc<=initial_soc
        raw=(folder/'rewards.jsonl').read_bytes(); assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
        events=[json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines()]; total_events+=len(events)
        totals=Counter(); hist={k:Counter() for k in ('first_stage','first_scope','first_resource','pool','search_exit','validation_result','outcome','cost_stop_candidate_reward','cost_stop_first_stage')}
        previous=initial_soc; repairs=0
        for index,e in enumerate(events,1):
            d=e['cost_diagnostics']; assert e['selection_id']==index and e['old_task_soc']==previous
            assert e['committed_gain']==e['old_task_soc']-e['committed_task_soc']>=0
            assert e['accepted'] or e['committed_gain']==0
            previous=e['committed_task_soc']
            if e['repair_attempt_id'] is not None:
                repairs+=1; assert e['repair_attempt_id']==repairs
            assert e['censored']==(e['local_deadline'] or e['global_deadline'])
            assert (d['first_observed_deadline'] is not None)==e['censored']
            first=d['first_observed_deadline']
            hist['first_stage'][first['stage'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['first_scope'][first['scope'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['first_resource'][first['resource'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            hist['pool'][str(d['eligible_topk_candidates']) if d['seed_pool_completed'] else 'UNKNOWN']+=1
            hist['search_exit'][d['search_loop_exit_stop']]+=1
            hist['validation_result'][d['validation_result']]+=1; hist['outcome'][e['outcome']]+=1
            for clock in ('wall','cpu'):
                v=d['candidate_validation_'+clock+'_ns']; post=d['post_search_through_settlement_'+clock+'_ns']; selection=e['selection_'+clock+'_before_log_ns']
                assert 0<=v<=post<=selection
                assert post==v+d['post_search_other_'+clock+'_ns']
                assert v==sum(d['candidate_'+p+'_'+clock+'_ns'] for p in ('materialization','joint_check','validation_other'))
                totals['selection_'+clock+'_ns']+=selection
                for key in ('candidate_validation','candidate_materialization','candidate_joint_check','candidate_validation_other','post_search_through_settlement','post_search_other'):
                    totals[key+'_'+clock+'_ns']+=d[key+'_'+clock+'_ns']
            totals['committed_gain']+=e['committed_gain']; totals['accepted']+=int(e['accepted'])
            totals['censored']+=int(e['censored']); totals['selections']+=1
            if e['candidate_validated']:
                assert e['candidate_reward']==e['old_subset_soc']-e['candidate_subset_soc']
            if d['search_loop_exit_stop']=='COST_STOP':
                assert not e['accepted'] and e['committed_gain']==0 and d['remaining_at_search_return']>0
                assert not e['candidate_validated'] or e['candidate_reward']<=0
                totals['cost_stop_count']+=1
                totals['cost_stop_validation_entered']+=int(d['validation_entered'])
                totals['cost_stop_validated']+=int(e['candidate_validated'])
                totals['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
                totals['cost_stop_selection_wall_ns']+=e['selection_wall_before_log_ns']
                hist['cost_stop_candidate_reward'][str(e['candidate_reward'])]+=1
                hist['cost_stop_first_stage'][first['stage'] if first else 'NONE']+=1
            if e['candidate_validated'] and e['candidate_reward']<=0:
                totals['validated_nonpositive_count']+=1
                totals['validated_nonpositive_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
            if e['accepted']: totals['accepted_validation_wall_ns']+=d['candidate_validation_wall_ns']
        assert previous==final_soc and totals['committed_gain']==initial_soc-final_soc
        assert len(events)==native['group_calls']==native['reward_contract']['selections']==native['reward_contract']['settlements']
        assert repairs==native['repair_attempts']==result['reward_diagnostics']['repairs']
        assert dict(hist['outcome'])==result['reward_diagnostics']['outcomes']
        for key,value in native['reward_contract']['cost_diagnostics'].items():
            if key!='schema': assert totals[key]==value
        diag=result['reward_diagnostics']['cost_diagnostics']
        assert dict(hist['first_stage'])==diag['first_observed_deadline_stage_counts']
        assert dict(hist['pool'])==diag['completed_eligible_topk_size_counts']
        assert dict(hist['validation_result'])==diag['validation_result_counts']
        family=job['case'].split('__')[0]
        family_data=families.setdefault(family,{'totals':Counter(),'hist':{k:Counter() for k in hist}})
        family_data['totals'].update(totals)
        for key in hist: family_data['hist'][key].update(hist[key])
        per_job.append({'job':job['id'],'status':'COMPLETE','initial_soc':initial_soc,'final_soc':final_soc,'initial_makespan':initial_makespan,'final_makespan':final_makespan,
            'entry_wall_ns':rec['total_entry_through_output_validation_and_hash_ns'],'outer_wall_ns':outer_row['outer_command_wall_ns'],
            'worker_cpu_ns':result['worker_cpu_ns'],'native_cpu_s':native['inner_cpu_s'],'largest_child_maxrss_kib':rec['costs']['largest_child_maxrss_kib'],
            'stage_wall_ns':result['stage_wall_ns'],'totals':dict(totals),'hist':{k:dict(v) for k,v in hist.items()},
            'validation_share_of_selection':totals['candidate_validation_wall_ns']/totals['selection_wall_ns'],
            'cost_stop_share_of_validation':totals['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/totals['candidate_validation_wall_ns']})
    aggregated={}
    for family,data in families.items():
        t=data['totals']; aggregated[family]={'totals':dict(t),'hist':{k:dict(v) for k,v in data['hist'].items()},
            'validation_share_of_selection':t['candidate_validation_wall_ns']/t['selection_wall_ns'],
            'cost_stop_share_of_validation':t['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/t['candidate_validation_wall_ns'],
            'cost_stop_validation_share_of_selection':t['cost_stop_validation_wall_ns']/t['selection_wall_ns']}
    return {'schema':'INDEPENDENT_READONLY_COST_AUDIT_V1','status':'PASS','source_receipt_sha256':EXPECTED,'manifest_sha256':MANIFEST,
        'input_sha256':cfg['input_sha256'],'scientific_code_commit':receipt['scientific_code_commit'],'original_batch_artifacts_verified':len(receipt['artifacts']),
        'per_job_artifact_pins_verified':total_pin_count,'events_verified':total_events,'full_initial_and_final_plans_independently_validated':12,
        'author_final_paths_equal_result_json':True,'new_search':False,'reruns':0,'per_job':per_job,'aggregated':aggregated,
        'next_single_change':'Common baseline: avoid complete joint candidate validation when current acceptance prerequisites already fail (especially COST_STOP / remaining_agents>0); retain existing rollback and final full-plan validation. Validate the changed ledger separately; do not call an unvalidated candidate valid or relabel truncated counterfactual rewards.',
        'limitations':['Known design tasks; within-task seeds are not independent tasks.','Validation is nested in post-search and selection; timings cannot be added.','First observed cutoff checkpoint is not the true crossing instant.','Potential saved recorded work is not measured end-to-end speedup or quality benefit.','Candidate eligibility/clock changes may alter future random sequence; no counterfactual trajectory equivalence is claimed.','Author arm summary audits committed outcomes, not its original posterior.']}
